tei:div.tei:p: (ca)༄༅// jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga zhig bsam/ de las 'od 'phros pas sha khrag gi lus dang sdig sgrib dag nas sems bcom ldan 'das mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog sngon po sprul pa'i sku'i cha lugs can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon/ g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ na bza' chos gos dmar po gsol ba zhig tu gyur par bsam/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de las 'od 'phros te rang 'dra ba'i ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ yid kyis phyag dang mchod pa bya/ gsol ba gdab/ dzaḥzhes brjod pas spyi bor byon/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas thim par gyur/ baṃ zhes brjod pas dbyer med du gyur/ hoḥzhes brjod pas dgyes bzhin du bzhugs par bsam/ de nas spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ mthing ga bsam/ de nas thugs ka'i hūm̐ las sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs la klog pa'i tshul du'am/ zhal nas 'thon te lte ba nas zhugs nas 'khor bar dmigs la bzla/ mi dmigs pa'i rgyas gdab par bya'o// mi 'khrugs pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bla ma'i

zhang ston pa/ zhal nas byon pa ltar bkod pa'o// ༈ /jo bo lugs kyi mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi sgrub thabs rjes gnang dang bcas pa'i cho ga sdig sgrib kun sbyong zhes bya ba bzhugs so// na mo gu ru badz+rā k+ṣo bh+yā ya/ 'dir jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nas rim par brgyud pa'i man ngag dge ba'i bshes gnyen bka' gdams pa rnams kyi thugs dam/ dpal snar thang gi mkhan po mchims chen nam mkha' grags kyis bsgrigs pa'i snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa las byung ba'i rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi rjes gnang la sbyor dngos gzhi rjes gsum las/ dang po ni/ gnas dben par stegs bu la ras sogs kyis bkab pa'i steng*/ maṇ+ḍal la pad+ma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbus su 'bras kyi tshom bu bkod/ mdun phyogs dbang ldan nas me'i bar du yi dam chos skyong gzhi bdag rnams kyi gtor ma zlum gtor gsum dang*/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du chu gnyis sngon 'gro'i nyer spyod dang*/ rang gi mdun du bum pa gnyis nang rdzas mgul chings kha brgyan dang ldan pa'i khar/ mchod yon gyi dung phor gzungs rdor dang bcas pa bsham/ gzhan yang rdo rje dril bu me tog gi snod sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams nyer bsdogs bya/ gnyis pa la slob dpon gyi bya ba mchod pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ oṃ āḥbigh+nan+ta kṛta hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswā bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ zhes pas stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las byung ba'i rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod yon/ zhabs bsil/ me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri chab/ zhal zas/ rol mo rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med pa nam mkha'i khams gang bar gyur par bsams la/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas te/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ swā hā nas shab+da swā hā'i bar dang dharmā ra ṇa rol mo bcas pas byin dbab/

de nas skyabs 'gro sems bskyed/ tshad med bzhi bsgom pa rnams spyi ltar sngon du song nas/ swa bhā wa sogs kyis stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rang gi snying gar a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros/ rang gi lus rnam smin sha khrag gdos bcas kyi phung po dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib dang bcas pa sbyangs/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sku mdog in+d+ra nī la ltar sngo ba/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la zhabs gnyis rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas sa gnon dang g.yon mnyam gzhag mdzad pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i spyan gnyis 'gro la gzigs shing dbu'i gtsug tor dang bcas pa/ na bza' chos gos dmar po sogs tshangs par spyod pa'i cha lugs can/ mtshan dang dpe byad kyis spras pa'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas ye shes sems dpa' bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drangs/ oṃ badz+ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da pra tīts+tsha swā hā'i bar gyis mchod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥzhes pas gnyis su med par bstim/ spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po/ slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa gong bzhin spyan drangs la mchod/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas de rnams kyis bdud rtsis gang ba'i bum pa thogs nas/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang*/ dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pa las rdo rje sems dpas dbur brgyan par bsam/ sngags bzla ba ni/ rang gi thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ yig gi mthar sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer 'phros/

'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs rje byin rlabs nus mthu thams cad 'od kyi rnam par bsdus nas rang la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya/ oṃ kaṃ ka ni kaṃ ka ni/ ro tsa ni ro tsa ni/ tro ṭa ni tro ṭa ni/ trā sa ni trā sa ni/ pra ti ha na pra ti ha na/ sarba karma pa raṃ pa rā ṇi me sarba satwā rāñca swā hā/ zhes pa ci nus bzla/ thun mtshams su bdag bskyed kyi ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar byon par bsams la/ de la/ oṃ sarba tā thā ga ta badz+ra ak+ṣo bh+ya sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da'i bar gyis mchod/ chos nyid mnyam pa nyid las ma g.yos kyang*// thugs rjes rtag tu mya ngan mi 'da' bar// mtha' yas 'gro ba'i don sgrub lhur len pa// bcom ldan mi 'khrugs pa la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces pas bstod/ bcom ldan 'das bdag dang sems can thams cad la mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub thams cad stsal du gsol/ zhes 'dod don zhus la/ ma 'byor pa dang sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa rang bzhin gyi gnas su gshegs/ nyer bsdu ni/ rang nyid lha sku gdan dang bcas pa 'od du zhu nas thugs ka'i sa bon la thim/ de'ang nā da'i bar du thim zhing nā da'ang mi dmigs pa'i ngang du mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba na slar yang skad cig gis lha'i skur gyur par bsam/ bdag bskyed tsam nyams su len na 'di'i mthar/ dge ba 'di yis myur du bdag /mi 'khrugs mgon po 'grub gyur nas// zhes sogs kyi bsngo ba dang smon lam brjod pas grub bo// rjes gnang dang 'brel ba la/ bum pa gnyis bsangs sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las baṃ baṃ las byung ba'i rin po che'i bum pa gnyis yangs shing rgya che ba/ mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang*/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan pa/ nang chu dang bcud thams cad dang ldan pa'i rnam rgyal bum pa'i dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing ga

de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sogs nas/ de'i thugs kar a las zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga zhes pa'i bar sgrub thabs ltar dang*/ las thams cad pa'i bum par pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du hūm̐ las bgegs mthar byed sku mdog sngon po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas rdo rje 'phyar ba'i tshul gyis 'dzin cing g.yon sdigs mdzub dang bcas pa'i zhags pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan zhing stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs g.yas bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas sogs nas/ mi 'khrugs pa dang bgegs mthar byed spyan drangs la bstim pa dang*/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlab pa dang dbang bskur ba rnams gong dang 'dra ba la spyi gtsug tu lud pa las mi 'khrugs pa la mi bskyod pa/ bgegs mthar byed la don yod grub pas dbur brgyan/ mchod bstod gong bzhin dang*/ bgegs mthar byed la/ 'jigs pa'i hūm̐ sgra sogs kyis bstod la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la 'khril te song*/ bum nang gi lha'i rgyud bskul ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas bum pa gang bar bsams la/ rnam rgyal la lha sngags brgya rtsa dang*/ las bum la oṃ bigh+nan+ta kṛ ta ces pa'ang ci rigs bzlas la/ 'dod don zhus mthar yig brgyas kha bskangs la/ las bum kha rgyan gyis chu 'thor ba dang bcas te/ ji srid rjes su gnang ba'i bya ba ma rdzogs kyi bar du bgegs zlog pa'i phrin las mdzod ces dang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes pa'ang cung zad bzlas na legs par mngon/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas mchod yon phul ba'i rkyen gyis ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa zhu ba bum pa'i chu'i rnam par gyur/ mdun bskyed maṇ+ḍal bsang sbyang*/

stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sogs nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa'i bar rang nyid ces pa dor ba ma gtogs bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar mi 'khrugs par bskyed de/ mchod pa byin gyis brlabs nas/ mtshan sngags re res thog drangs pa'i chu gnyis nyer spyod rol mo dang bcas pas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa ci rigs par byas la 'dod don gsol ba gdab bo// de nas gtor ma dang po bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las rin po che las grub pa'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis byin gyis brlab/ lha'i sngags la i daṃ ba lin+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ btags pa lan gsum gyis phul la/ mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma gnyis pa 'bru gsum brjod pas bdud rtsir byas la/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ dpal rdo rje nag po chen po la sogs pa bstan srung dam tshig can rnams oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥzhes pas spyan drangs la/ oṃ shrī dharmā pā la sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs lan gsum gyis bsngos la/ bstan srung dam tshig can khyed rnams kyis mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di bzhes la sangs rgyas gyi bstan pa dar ba dang*/ bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa'i chos sgrub pa'i 'gal rkyen bar chad thams cad zhi zhing rnam par dkar ba'i phrin las dang 'gro don thams cad rtag tu rgyas pa'i phrin las sdong grogs rgya chen po mdzad du gsol/ zhes dang*/ gtor ma gsum pa'ang byin gyis brlabs nas/ slar yang snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas/

'dzam bu'i gling spyi dang bre brag ljongs 'dir gnas pa'i sa bdag gzhi bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa thams cad ā kar+ṣa ya dzaḥ zhes lcags kyu'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas bkug na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta sogs kyis bsngo/ mchod sbyin gyi gtor ma 'di sa bdag gzhi bdag dkor bdag gnyug mar gnas pa rnams la 'bul lo// bdag cag dpon slob 'khor dang bcas pa la gnod 'tshe'i bsam sbyor thams cad spangs nas/ ji ltar bsam pa'i don thams cad gegs med du 'grub pa'i sdong grogs dam pa mdzod cig ces dang*/ sarba bhū mi pa ti gats+tsha rang rang gi gnas su gshegs par bsam/ de nas slob ma rnams khrus dang phyag byas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa la/ slob dpon gyis zang zing med pa'i byams pa dang 'khor ba las bsgral bar 'dod pa'i snying rjes kun nas bslangs te/ sems can thams cad kyi don du bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi go 'phang thob par bya/ de'i ched du rjes su gnang ba zab mo gsan la don nyams su blang snyam pa byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa gsal btab nas gsan 'tshal/ de la 'dir gang gsan par bya ba'i rjes su gnang ba ni/ 'phags pa'i yul gyi paṇ+ḍi ta chen po kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir thub pa'i bstan pa rin po che'i snang byed du gyur pa/ sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi ye shes sgyu 'phrul drwa ba'i rol pa jo bo chen po a ti sha nas brgyud pa'i yi dam lha'i mngon par rtogs pa rjes gnang man ngag thor bur bzhugs pa rnams snar thang gi mkhan chen mchims nam mkha' grags kyis phyogs gcig tu bsgrigs par brten/ snar thang brgya rtsar grags pa'i bstan bcos chen po las byung ba'i yi dam gyi lha khyad par can rnams las/ 'dir skabs su babs pa bya rgyud rdo rje'i rigs kyi gtso bo 'phags pa las kyi sgrib pa thams cad rnam par sbyong ba zhes bya ba'i gzungs las/

rtag tu bzlas brjod byas na las gcig nas gcig tu brgyud pa thams cad rnam par dag par 'gyur ro// dus gsum du bzlas brjod byas na mtshams med pa lnga yang byang bar 'gyur ro// lan gcig bzlas brjod byas na ltas ngan pa dang*/ bkra mi shis pa rnams med par 'gyur ro// lus la 'chang ngam/ glegs bam la bris nas mgul du thogs te 'chang na dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams gtan du 'byung bar mi 'gyur ro// gang zhig snying rjes non te ri dwags dang*/ bya dang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin kyang rung ste/ 'chi ba'i rna khung du brjod na de ngan song du 'gro bar mi 'gyur ro// zhes sogs nas/ mtshams med pa lnga byed pa'am/ dam pa'i chos spangs pa'am/ 'phags pa la skur pa btab pa'ang rung ste/ 'chi khar rtsigs pa la gzungs sngags 'di bris pa mthong na de'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad par 'gyur na/ 'don pa dang bzlas brjod byas na lta ci smos/ ces gzungs 'don pa'am/ mthong ba tsam gyis kyang sdig sgrib thams cad yongs su sbyong zhing*/ 'khor ba dang ngan song gi sdug bsngal las grol bar mdzad pas mtshon byin rlabs dang thugs rje'i gter chen po bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa gtso rkyang gi rjes su gnang ba sgrub pa la slob dpon gyis bgyi par 'os pa thams cad grub nas/ khyed rnams kyi ngo skal du gyur pa la/ slob dpon lhag pa'i lha dang tha mi dad snyam pa'i mos gus dang ldan pas rjes gnang zab mo zhu ba'i yon du dmigs te maṇ+ḍal 'bul bar zhu/ de ltar maṇ+ḍal phul nas me tog dang bcas pas thal mo sbyar nas gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ skye rga na dang 'chi ba yi// chu srin la sogs 'jig rung ba// srid pa'i mtsho las bdag sgrol mdzod// dga' chen ston pa khyod gcig pu// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon pos bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum/

sdom pa gzung ba'i slad du dmigs pa 'di bzhin mdzod/ gnas khang 'di nyid tha mal gyi rnam pa can ma yin pa dag gsal gnyis su med pa'i zhing khams yin snyam pa dang*/ bla ma yang lhag pa'i lha dngos yin snyam pa dang*/ mdun bskyed kyi maṇ+ḍal 'di yang bsgrubs zin pa ltar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa sogs nas skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa zhes pa'i bar brjod pas ngo sprod/ de dag gi steng gi nam mkhar bla ma dang mtha' skor du yi dam sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mkha' 'gro chos skyong gi tshogs sprin ltar gtibs nas bzhugs par mos te/ de rnams kyi spyan sngar bdag dang mtha' yas pa'i sems can thams cad 'khod de/ tshe rabs thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i sdig pa bshags pa la sogs pa'i yan lag bdun pa bgyi snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi sogs nas/ 'gro la phan phyir sangs rgyas 'grub par shog /ces pas sdom pa phog nas/ dngos gzhi la sku'i rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// sku yi rdo rje slob dpon gyis// bdag la rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i// sku yi rjes gnang stsal du gsol// zhes lan gsum/ gsol gdab 'di sku gsung thugs so sor mi thub pa ltar na/ skabs 'dir gsum char bsdams te/ de'ang dngos gzhi'i don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod ces brda sprad la/ dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rdo rje gsum bdag slob dpon gyis// bdag la rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i// rjes su gnang ba stsal du gsol// zhes brjod pas btub ste bla ma'i phyag len la'ang de ltar mchis/ mchims sogs mkhas pa'i yig cha 'ga' zhig tu 'dir gsol gdab bya ba ma bshad par yod pa'i phyir ro// de nas slob ma las bum gyi chu dang las sngags kyis bsang*/

swa bhā was slob ma'i phung khams skye mched stong par sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang*/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ khyed rang rnams kyi sems nyid hūm̐ mthing ga de las 'od zer 'phros/ 'phags pa mchod/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ de yongs su gyur pa las/ khyed rang rnams skad cig gis bcom ldan 'das rdo rje'i mi 'khrugs pa sogs nas/ thugs kar zla ba'i steng du hūm̐ mthing ga zhes pa'i bar gyis bskyed/ de'i spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ thugs kar hūm̐ sngon po dang bcas pa gsal btab/ slob dpon rdo rje mi 'khrugs par gsal ba la mos gus byas pas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros/ mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te de dag thams cad kyi sku'i byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sku'i rnam pa che ba ri rab tsam nas chung ba nyungs 'bru tsam gyi bar bgrang du med cing bsam gyis mi khyab pa spyan drangs te steng nas byon pa thams cad kha ba bu yug 'tshubs pa lta bu/ 'og nas byon pa rnams dbyar gyi sa rlangs rdol ba lta bu/ bar nas byon pa rnams dge 'dun mang po chos 'khor la 'du ba lta bur byon/ khyed rang rnams kyi spyi bo'i gtsug dbang po'i sgo/ ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas mtsho chen po la kha ba babs pa ltar sib sib thim par mos pa mdzod/ spro na dril gsil dang bcas/ ma lus sems can zhes pa nas gshegs su gsol/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs la/ badz+ra ā be sha ya aḥ.āḥ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥmang du brjod pas bstim/ slar yang slob dpon gyi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa rdo rje bsdu ba'i sngags rgyas spyan drangs/ de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis rdo rje slob ma 'di rnams la mngon par dbang bskur pa stsal du gsol/

zhes gsol ba btab pas/ de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes dang bum chu spyi bor gtor la 'thung du gzhug ces dbang bskur bas sku'i byin rlabs thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag lha'i sku 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pa las de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ de ltar khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la/ oṃ ar+ghaṃ nas shab+da dril gsil bar bya/ zhes pas mchod pa dang bcas pa ni sku'i rjes gnang ngo*// gsung gi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs pa 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ sngar gyi gsol ba 'debs par gsung gi zhes 'don pa bsgyur la gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon dang mdun bskyed kyi lha gnyis ka'i thugs ka'i sa bon sngags phreng dang bcas pa las sngags phreng gnyis pa mar me gcig la gnyis mched kyi tshul du byung*/ zhal nas thon/ sngags phreng las 'od zer 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi gsung gi byin rlabs thams cad sngags phreng gi rnam par spyan drangs pa rnams dang lhan cig tu khyed rnams kyi zhal du zhugs/ thugs ka'i sa bon gyi mthar g.yas skor gyis 'khod par mos la sngags 'di'i rjes zlos lan gsum mdzod ces dang*/ na mo rat+na tra yā ya sogs kyi rjes zlos byar gzhug de ltar gsum bzlas pas dang pos rgyud byin gyis brlabs/ gnyis pas dbyer med du byas/ gsum pas brtan par byas par mos te/ slob dpon la me tog 'thor bzhin pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ bcom ldan bdag gi gzung lags kyis// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon gyis kyang me tog de dag sngags kyi phreng ba'i rang bzhin du byas te khyed rnams kyi spyi bor bzhag pas snying ga'i sngags nus pa dang ldan par byin gyis brlabs pa'i mos pa mdzod ces dang*/

bcom ldan 'di la stsal lags kyis// 'di la nye bar mdzad du gsol// sngags kyi dngos grub thob pa dang*// brtul zhugs brtan par mdzad du gsol// de brtan pa'i ched du nam mkhar bzhugs pa'i dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa nas sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas gsung gi byin rlabs thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag lha'i gsung 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pas pad+ma'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la gong bzhin mchod pa dang bcas pa ni gsung gi rjes gnang ngo*// thugs kyi rjes gnang gi don du gsol ba 'debs par thugs zhes 'don pa bsgyur la gsol ba btab nas/ slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros mdun bskyed kyi lha dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs kar phog pas thugs rgyud bskul te/ de dag thams cad kyi thugs kyi byin rlabs thams cad rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i sku dang phyag mtshan gyi rnam par spyan drangs/ khyed rang rnams kyi snying gar thim/ snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas snod bcud thams cad la phog pas de thams cad 'od du zhu nas khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la thim/ de'ang 'od phung du zhu nas snying ga'i sa bon la thim/ de yang je chung je phrar gyur te mthar nam mkha' la 'ja' yal ba ltar yal te gzung 'dzin gnyis snang gis bsdus pa'i chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma dmigs pa'i spros bral stong pa nyid kyi ngang du cung zad mnyam par 'jog pa zhu/ stong pa'i ngang las skad cig gis zab gsal gnyis su med pa lhag pa'i lha yi skur gyur par mos pa mdzod/ de brtan pa'i ched du dbang gi lha rnams dang slob dpon gyis/ ji ltar bltams pa sogs kyis bum pa'i chus dbang bskur bas thugs kyi byin rlabs thob/ yid kyi dri ma dag

lha'i thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'grub pa'i bag chags bzhag chu'i lhag ma spyi gtsug tu lud pas rdo rje'i rigs kyi lhas dbur brgyan par gyur/ khyed rnams lhar gsal ba la gong ltar mchod pa dang bcas pa ni thugs kyi rjes gnang ngo*// spro na/ de dag brtan pa'i yan lag tu dkon mchog gsum gyi bkra shis brjod/ de dag gi gnas skabs su thob cing khas blangs pa'i dam tshig dang sdom pa tshul bzhin bsrung snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ gtso bos ji ltar sogs lan gsum/ zhes khas blangs nas rjes su gnang ba thob pa'i gtang rag tu maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ maṇ+ḍal du ma zad lus longs spyod rnams kyang 'bul gyi bzhes nas longs spyod du gsol snyam pas 'di'i rjes zlos mdzod/ deng nas brtsams te sogs lan gsum/ des bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i rjes su gnang ba gsan pa yin pas rang gzhan gyi don rgya chen po mdzad par zhu/ bsod nams 'di yis sogs kyis dge ba bsngos la slob ma rnams rang gnas su btang*/ gsum pa rjes mchod pa kha gsos te tshom bu la mchod bstod dang 'dod don gsol ba gdab/ yig brgya dang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa sogs kyis lhag chad kha bskang zhing nongs pa bzod par gsol/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad ces sogs kyi mthar oṃ badz+ra muḥzhes dang*/ mtheb srin gyi se gol dang bcas pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya'o// bsnyen pa byed na/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas gzungs 'bum phrag gcig kha skong dang bcas pa bzla/ bzlas dmigs spyir dkyus su gsal ba ltar la/ sngags phreng dkar po g.yas skor du 'khor ba las 'od zer dkar po bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'phros/ lus kyi nang thams cad gang*/ tshe 'khor ba thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i nad gdon sdig sgrib thams cad byang zhing dag par byas/

ba spu'i bu ga dang smin mtshams nas thon/ phyogs bcu'i zhing khams rab 'byams su spros pa las mchod pa'i sprin chen por gyur te rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa mchod/ khams gsum thams cad snang bar byas/ rigs drug so so'i sdug bsngal rgyu dang bcas pa sbyangs shing rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa'i go 'phang la bkod/ tshur 'dus snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim pas rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsam la bzla/ dmigs pa gcig kho nas sems dub na/ lha'i gsal snang dang*/ sngags kyi gzugs dang*/ sgra dang*/ 'od zer spro bsdu dang*/ chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i dbyings su mnyam par 'jog pa ste/ mdor na tha mal gyi 'khrul pa'i rjes su yid g.yengs pa spangs te rtse gcig tu bzlas shing*/ skabs rer rgya gzhung gi dgongs pa ltar/ thugs ka'i sngags phreng las sngags phreng gnyis pa byung*/ zhal nas thon/ 'od zer spro bsdu sngar bzhin mthar lte ba nas zhugs/ snying ga'i sngags phreng la thim par bsam pa'ang ting nge 'dzin gyi rtsal 'byong ba'i gnad dam pa'o// snga thun gyi mjug tu gtor ma 'bul na/ bdag bskyed kyi nyer bsdu grub nas/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gtor ma bsang sbyang byin gyis brlab gtor mgron rgyas par bskyed pa'am/ rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje mi 'khrugs pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs kyis bskor ba oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥs spyan drangs mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la gtor ma gong bzhin phul/ mchod bstod 'dod gsol/ yi ge brgya pa'i mthar nongs pa bshags/ rten yod na brtan bzhugs dang*/ med na gshegs gsol/ bsngo smon shis brjod bcas bya/ gzhan mtshams kyi spang blang sogs spyi ltar shes par byas la nyams su blang ngo*// gzungs sgrub byed na/ zla ba gang yang rung ba'i nya la maṇ+ḍal me tog dkar po bkram pa'i dbus su bum pa bcud ldan kha rgyan mgul chings gzungs rdor dang bcas pa bsham/

bdag bskyed sngon du 'gro bas bum pa bsang sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa mtshan nyid thams cad yongs su rdzogs shing nang chu dang bcud sna tshogs kyis gang ba'i dbus su a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i dbus su oṃ/ mdun nas brtsams te g.yas skor du gzungs sngags kyi yi ge rnams nor bu chu shel gyi phreng ba ltar dkar zhing bsil ba'i reg bya dang ldan pa las 'od zer 'phros/ bum chu la thim pas bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur/ yang 'od zer 'phros/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi thugs ka nas ye shes kyi bdud rtsi spyan drangs/ bum pa'i bdud rtsi la thim/ de dang lhan cig tu rang gi thugs ka nas kyang sngags kyi nus pa thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam pa gzungs thag la 'khril te bum pa'i nang du zhugs pas bcud bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du byin gyis brlabs par bsams la gzungs ci nus su bzla/ mthar sngags phreng gdan dang bcas pa bdud rtsir dkar ltem gyis 'od du zhu nas bum chu dang dbyer med du gyur par bsams la bsngo smon shis brjod rgyas par bya/ de ltar bsgrubs pa'i bum chu de nyid rang gzhan gyis bkrus shing btung bas sdig sgrib thams cad byang ba dang*/ tshe 'das kyi ro'am/ rus pa'am/ dur khrod kyi sar gtor na sdig sgrib thams cad sbyong zhing*/ ngan song du skyes kyang zhag bdun nas thar bar 'gyur ro// tshul de bzhin du sa'am til lam/ yungs kar sogs bsgrub gzhi gang yang rung ba'i steng du sngags phreng bkod pa dang*/ 'od zer spro bsdu sogs kyi mthar bskyed gzhir bstim pa gong ltar byas pas kyang ji skad bshad pa'i phan yon 'byung ste/ 'di dag ni gzungs dang*/ jo bo lugs kyi yig rnying gzhan las ji ltar 'byung ba bzhin bkod pa'o// gzhan yang gzungs sngags 'di nyid rtsig pa la sogs pa'i ngos su bris pa sems can gang dag gis mthong ba dang*/

tha na 'chi kha ma'i mig lam du lan cig tsam mthong bas kyang*/ mtshams med pa lnga byas su zin yang las kyi sgrib pa thams cad zad pa dang*/ sems can gang zhig 'chi kha ma'i rna lam du snying rje chen po sngon du 'gro bas gzungs sngags 'di brjod pas ngan song du mi 'gro ba dang*/ gro ga'am/ shing shun sogs la gur gum gyis bris te lus sam mgul du 'chang na sdig sgrib thams cad zad cing dus ma yin par 'chi ba rnams mi 'byung ba dang*/ khyad par cho 'phrul chen po la sogs pa'i zla ba'i yar gyi ngor ring bsrel dang bcas pa'i sku gzugs sam mchod rten gyi drung du ci 'byor pa'i mchod pa bsham/ gos gsar pa bgo zhing khrus dang gtsang sbra la gnas pas/ theg pa chen po'i gso sbyong blang*/ gzungs kyi mjug gi pa rā ṇi zhes pa'i mtshams tshe 'das kyi ming spel ba'i mthar swā hā sbyar ba bzla ba'am/ bdag gi rnal 'byor ji skad bshad pa bzhin gsal btab la/ sngags phreng gi 'od zer spro bsdu'i skabs rigs drug spyi dang*/ bye brag tu dmigs yul gyi sdig sgrib sbyong bar bsam la bzlas brjod 'bum phrag sogs bgyis pas de nyid nges par ngan 'gro las thar te gnas gtsang ma'i lha yi ris su skye bar 'gyur ba dang*/ des mtshon te gzungs tshe 'das kyi ming spel dang bcas pa snying por byas pa'i sāts+tsha 'bum la sogs pa gzungs sngags bzla bzhin du btab ste/ mthar mchod pa rgya chen po dang bcas te rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu klung du spyan drangs pa'am/ yang na lam gyi bzhi mdor khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten du bkur sti dang bcas bzhugs su gsol ba dang*/ de ltar 'grub pa'i slad du 'phags pa'i dge 'dun la/ chos ston gsol zhing bsngo smon gyi mtshams sbyor ba bskul bas dmigs yul de nyid mod la ngan 'gro nas thar zhing mtho ris su skye bar 'gyur bas mtshon phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab par gsungs pas/

gcig tu rang dang*/ gzhan la phan par 'dod cing*/ snying rje chen po'i gzhan dbang du gyur pa theg pa chen po'i rigs sad pa rnams kyis g.yar dam du bzung bar ci gnang zhes gsol ba 'debs so// zhes pa'ang blo gros dang stobs dang 'byor pa sogs khyad par dang thun mong gi yon tan cha phra mo'ang dben pas gzhan la dngos su phan pa'i skabs lta ci/ de lta mod kyi sman 'dod kyi lhag bsam tsam zhig yid kyi khur du rtag par lci ba'i bya bral ba 'du shes gsum pa mañju gho ṣas/ byang chub sems dpa' chen po zhi ba 'tsho'i rnam par 'phrul pa zhu chen ma hā paṇ+ḍi ta tshul khrims rin chen gyi gsung rang gtso bor bzung*/ gzungs dang yig rnying gi gsal byed 'ga' zhig kyang sbyar te bris pa'i dge bas skye ba thog ma med pa nas byang chub bar du mthong thos dran reg gi yid can thams cad sgrib gnyis bag chags dang bcas pa zhi zhing*/ stobs bcu mnga' pa'i go 'phang mchog la myur du reg pa'i rgyur gyur cig/ //maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/ skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
